description: List the products this workspace keeps on a live refresh (set up with track_product), each with its current price, buy-box seller and fulfillment, stock state, seller count, the refresh interval and when it was last read, plus the most recent buy-box points (price and seller over time). Use when the user asks 'what changed on my tracked products', 'show my tracked ASINs', 'any buy-box changes'.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR. Amazon only.

points.description: How many recent buy-box points per product (max 24).

name: list_tracked
